_comment: Sentry alert 1464000 (org myown-76, de.sentry.io), applied by the agent through the Sentry MCP (create_alert_rule / update_alert_rule). Every save API error emails the owner, at most once per 30 min per issue, and opens a GitHub issue labelled incident through Sentry's GitHub integration (integration 558317, installed 2026-11-08): that issue wakes the on-call agent (.github/workflows/oncall.yml). Sentry opens one GitHub issue per Sentry issue.
name: Save API error (a save or load failed): email owner, wake the on-call agent
